text: the birth of the greatest creation of Allah, [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]].
Now, even in his birth, the birth of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]], there were amazing incidents that happened.

And these were signs from Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] that this boy is not just a regular boy, there is something special about this boy. So there were many signs, many incidents at his birth that showed that this was someone special.
And one of those incidents is mentioned by [[Hassan ibn Thabit|حَسَّان بن ثَابِت]] [[radiyallahu 'anhu|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ]], the poet of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]].

[[Hassan ibn Thabit|حَسَّان بن ثَابِت]], and [[Hassan ibn Thabit|حَسَّان بن ثَابِت]] [[radiyallahu 'anhu|رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ]], he was seven years older than [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]]. He was seven years older than the Prophet [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]], so when the Prophet [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]] was born, [[Hassan ibn Thabit|حَسَّان بن ثَابِت]] was seven years old.

So he narrates, and he remembers this, and he witnessed this himself. He said that he was in [[Madinah|مدينة]] at that time. [[Hassan ibn Thabit|حَسَّان بن ثَابِت]], he was in [[Madinah|مدينة]], and the Prophet [[ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam|ﷺ]] was born in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].
But [[Hassan ibn Thabit|حَسَّان بن ثَابِت]] said, "I remember this incident happened when I was seven years old." And he was with the Jews of [[Madinah|مدينة]], and we spoke about how the Jews...
